Synopsis:
BYD reported a fourth consecutive month of rising global sales in August, up 17.8% YoY to 440k vehicles, driven by surging exports (+134.5% to 189k units). International revenue surpassed domestic revenue for the first time in H1. Key growth markets include Europe, Southeast Asia, and Brazil, where BYD is launching local EV/PHEV production. Domestic profitability remains under pressure from intense competition in China's saturated EV market.
